summary: Fixed all five confirmed findings; full VM validation and the sr-core Python oracle passed.
body:
Fix-round files changed:

- Engine: `crates/engine/src/{vpkg.rs,vpkg_tests.rs,interchange.rs,lib.rs}`.
- UI: `crates/ui-egui/src/menus.rs` and `i18n/{ru,uk}.tsv`.
- Documentation: `docs/control-protocol.md`, `ATTRIBUTION.md`.

Round-0 changes were preserved. The integrator’s Cargo.lock refresh was not altered. No commits or pushes were made.

Public API remains unchanged:

```text
file.importVpkg {
  path: str, dir?: str,
  mode?: "rendered" | "native" | "hybrid",  // default hybrid
  lenient?: bool                          // default false
}
file.exportVpkg {
  path: str, sequence?: id,
  id?: str, version?: str, title?: str
}
```

Export defaults remain the sequence-name slug, version `1.0.0`, and sequence name. Import retains the scene result plus `package: {id, version, title, primaryScene, extractedTo, warnings}`; export returns `{path, bytes, report}`.

```rust
pub fn import(s: &mut Session, p: &Value) -> Result<Value>;
pub fn export(s: &mut Session, p: &Value) -> Result<Value>;
```

Added shared, crate-private preparation/merge helpers:

```rust
pub(crate) fn prepare_scene(
    s: &Session, path: &str, bytes: &[u8], mode: &str, lenient: bool,
) -> Result<PreparedScene>;
pub(crate) fn finish_scene(s: &mut Session, prepared: PreparedScene) -> Result<Value>;
```

All findings were confirmed and fixed:

1. Generated overlay destinations are preflighted before extraction and written through `Services::write_package_file`. An escaping overlay-directory symlink causes failure before any extraction writes.
2. Primary-scene references follow the verifier’s URI rules: remove query/fragment suffixes, decode percent escapes once, and preserve image-sequence patterns. Resulting media paths receive containment checks before opening. Rendered imports use a derived `<primary>.filmcraft.scene` when normalization changes the document; verified originals remain byte-identical. Nonlocal primary references are refused before extraction.
3. `Session::edit_group` groups import and synchronous ingest edits into one undo step, preserving Copy ingest.
4. Both menu labels now have Russian and Ukrainian translations.
5. Native package writes remove newly created incomplete files after write/sync failure. Errors identify the extraction directory, earlier retained files, and any cleanup failure. Explicit-directory retry can reuse successful entries.

No new XSD mapping decisions were introduced. URI handling follows [sr-core refs.py](/home/admin/src/sr-core/sr_core/vpkg/refs.py), particularly `_value_path`, and FilmCraft’s verifier resolution policy. Its `INPUTS`, `CACHES`, and URI policy were adapted from revision `babeccf0ca0cb2603b8f6a1d3cb07388b7d7a2cc` (MIT). Provenance was added to ATTRIBUTION.md and the copyright/license notice retained in `vpkg.rs`. No new dependencies were added.

TDD red → green evidence:

| Regression | Observed red failure | Final result |
|---|---|---|
| `vpkg_fix_overlay_symlink_preflight` | Import followed the overlay symlink and returned `Ok` | Pass |
| `vpkg_fix_uri_escape_and_suffix` | `linkedMedia` was 0 instead of 1 | Pass across native, hybrid, rendered, and overlays; includes exactly-once decoding |
| `vpkg_fix_query_never_opens_external_file` | Opened the unverified external file | Pass |
| `vpkg_fix_rendered_ingest_one_undo` | Two undo steps instead of one | Pass, Copy ingest retained |
| `vpkg_fix_failed_extraction_recovery_context` | Only `README.md: disk full` was reported | Pass, including retry |
| `vpkg_fix_partial_native_write_is_removed` | Truncated file remained | Pass |
| `vpkg_fix_ru_uk_translations` | Missing `Scene Package…` translation | Pass |

The image-sequence control fixture needed required frame bounds; the expanded overlay assertion needed to account for the retained image asset. Both test corrections are recorded separately from product defects. `%02d` and `##` controls pass. [TDD log](/tmp/vpkg-fix-tdd.md), [red output](/tmp/vpkg-fix-red1.log).

Final VM gate exited **0**:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo fmt --check` | Passed |
| Workspace clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Engine | 695 passed, 3 ignored |
| UI unit/integration tests | 644 passed, 4 ignored |
| VPKG including doctest | 35 passed, 2 ignored |
| Interchange | 320 passed, 7 ignored |
| `cargo xtask layers` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask wasm` | Passed, 51 crates |

Total: **1,694 passed, zero failed, 16 ignored**. The separate oracle ran with `SR_CORE_DIR=$HOME/sr-core`; `python3 -m sr_core.vpkg verify` printed `export.vpkg.zip: ok`. [Full validation log](/tmp/vpkg-fix-gate3.log).

All builds/tests ran through the VM wrapper, using two build jobs and two test threads. Earlier successfully extracted files intentionally remain after a later write failure; errors now provide recovery context. Coordination task completed and locks released.
